findings: DINOv3 constructor calls Transformers from_pretrained without an immutable revision or local-only flag
Remover constructor enables trust_remote_code with no pinned revision
Base loader catches any primary model load exception and attempts another location

decision: Keep TRELLIS.2 outside default permissive capability selection. Any optional pack requires explicit component terms plus pinned local loaders and independent ARM64 qualification. Do not replace DINOv3 with DINOv2 and claim equivalent model behavior.
